user.title: PSEG Long Island
user.description:
Choose how Home Assistant should sign in to mysmartenergy.psegliny.com.

**Email and password** signs in automatically and renews the session whenever PSEG expires it, so you never paste a cookie again. **Browser session cookie** is the fallback for accounts with a security question, an SMS/email verification code or a reCAPTCHA prompt.

For cookie mode: open the portal, press F12, go to Network, reload, click the `Dashboard` request and copy the whole value of the `Cookie` request header.

data_description.auth_mode: Automatic sign-in needs your PSEG account credentials; cookie mode uses a session you already have in a browser.
data_description.email: The email address you use at mysmartenergy.psegliny.com.
data_description.password: Stored in Home Assistant's config entry and only sent to mysmartenergy.psegliny.com.
data_description.cookie: Only needed in cookie mode. The Cookie header from a logged-in MySmartEnergy session.
data_description.name: Friendly name for this PSEG account.

reauth_confirm.title: Refresh the PSEG session
reauth_confirm.description: The PSEG session has expired. With a stored password this completes on its own; otherwise log in at mysmartenergy.psegliny.com again and paste a fresh Cookie header.

data_description.auth_mode: Switch to a session cookie if your account asks for a verification code.
data_description.email: The email address you use at mysmartenergy.psegliny.com.
data_description.password: Leave empty to keep the stored password.

error.invalid_auth: PSEG rejected those credentials or that cookie.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the PSEG portal. Try again in a few minutes.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log for details.
error.credentials_required: Enter both the PSEG email address and password, or switch to the session cookie method.
error.cookie_required: Paste the Cookie header from a logged-in MySmartEnergy session.
error.verification_required: PSEG asked for a security question, verification code, reCAPTCHA or password change. Sign in at mysmartenergy.psegliny.com by hand and use the session cookie method instead.

abort.already_configured: PSEG Long Island is already configured.

init.title: PSEG tariff and history
init.description: Costs are estimated from these values. PSEG publishes a new power supply charge every month, so update the supply rate when your bill changes. The daily service charge is added once per day in the period totals and is not included in the hourly cost statistic.

data_description.rate_mode: Use 'flat' if your bill has one delivery rate all day, or 'tou' for a time-of-day rate.
data_description.delivery_rate: Delivery portion in USD per kWh. For a TOU rate this is the off-peak value.
data_description.supply_rate: Power supply charge in USD per kWh for the current month.
data_description.peak_delivery_rate: Delivery portion during peak hours, USD per kWh.
data_description.peak_supply_multiplier: Multiplier applied to the supply charge during peak hours (PSEG TOU rates use a value above 1).
data_description.daily_service_charge: Fixed charge in USD per day.
data_description.peak_start_hour: Local hour when peak pricing begins (24h clock).
data_description.peak_end_hour: Local hour when peak pricing ends (24h clock).
data_description.week_start: Which day the 'this week' sensor starts on.
data_description.billing_day: Day of the month your billing cycle starts, used by the cycle sensors.
data_description.backfill_days: How much history to download on first setup. 0 disables the automatic backfill.
data_description.timestamp_offset_minutes: Only change this if PSEG timestamps look shifted in your timezone. Positive values move readings later.

backfill.name: Backfill usage
backfill.description: Download historical hourly usage from PSEG and import it into long-term statistics.
